TERMINAL IS STILL SHUT DOWN AND EVACUATED AND REACTING PRODUCT IS BEING DILUTED WITH WATER AND SHOVELED INTO METAL DRUMS WHILE BEING DILUTED WITH WATER.

properties.title: NRC Report: Lead near Grantsville, UT
properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 895552 - Medium Affected: SOIL - Suspected Responsible Party: VECTOR ARMS, INC.
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 895552
Incident Time: 2007-05-12 20:00:00
Nearest City: Grantsville, UT
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: LEAD
Medium Affected: SOIL
Suspected Responsible Party: VECTOR ARMS, INC.
Skytruth Analysis
ON MAY 12, 2007 AT APPROXIMATELY 3 P.M. A BLM RANGER AND A VOLUNTEER DISCOVERED A LARGE GROUP PEOPLE (OVER 37) SHOOTING AT A MINI-VAN USING AUTOMATIC WEAPONS IN A GRAVEL PIT SOUTH OF INTERSTATE I-80 AT THE SKULL VALLEY TURNOFF , APPROXIMATELY 13 MILES TO THE EAST OF GRANTSVILLE, UTAH. UPON INVESTIGATION THE RANGER DISCOVERED THE UNAUTHORIZED EVENT WAS SPONSORED BY VECTOR ARMS, INC. AS AN EMPLOYEE APPRECIATION EVENT. PEOPLE INTERVIEWED SAID ALL FLUIDS HAD BEEN DRAINED FROM THE VEHICLE BEFORE IT WAS USED FOR TARGET PRACTICE. AN ACCELERANT, “TANNERITE”, WAS USED TO FACILIATATE AN EXPLOSION AND FIRE WHEN SHOT BY THE PARTICIPANTS OF THE EVENT. THE TOOELE COUNTY FIRE DEPARTMENT ARRIVED AROUND 4:15 P.M. AND EXTINGUISHED THE MINI-VAN FIRE STARTED BY THE TARGET SHOOTING AND A SMALL RELATED GRASS FIRE THAT ALSO STARTED. A GOVERNMENT HAZMAT CONTRACTOR COLLECTED SOIL SAMPLES FOR LABORATORY ANALYSIS. LABORATORY ANALYSIS INDICATED THE PRESENCE OF ARSENIC, BARIUM, CADMIUM, CHROMIUM, LEAD, SELENIUM, AND SILVER. ONLY LEAD EXCEED THE TCLP REGULATORY LIMIT OF 5 PPM (PARTS PER MILLION), BEING 6.8 PPM AT THE SITE. TOTAL LEAD HAS BEEN REPORTED TO BE 46,000 MG/KG AT ONE SAMPLING LOCATION AND IS THE BASIS FOR DETERMINING THAT THE REPORTABLE FOR LEAD HAS BEEN EXCEEDED. ESTIMATED LABORATORY ANALYSIS AND CLEANUP COSTS EXCEED $13,000. CLEANUP OF THE SITE IS STILL PENDING.
